question: Team IS1004 discussed speech recognition. Who decided against it, what reasons were given, and what did the final remote use instead to be found?
answer: Speaker A (Project Manager) decided against speech recognition, citing uncertainty that it would work and difficulty guaranteeing performance; Speaker B (User Interface Designer) also raised TV background noise and said speech recognition was inappropriate for a TV environment. Instead, the final design used a base station with a button that makes the remote beep so it can be found when lost.
